tasks.label: Check LAN IPv4
tasks.command: Get-NetIPAddress -AddressFamily IPv4 | Where-Object { $_.IPAddress -notlike '127.*' -and $_.IPAddress -notlike '169.254.*' } | Select-Object InterfaceAlias,IPAddress | Format-Table -AutoSize

tasks.label: Inspect RecipeMaster API listener
tasks.command: $listener = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5001 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $listener | Select-Object LocalAddress,LocalPort,OwningProcess | Format-Table -AutoSize; $listener | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique | ForEach-Object { Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "ProcessId = $_" | Select-Object ProcessId,Name,CommandLine | Format-List }

tasks.label: Restart RecipeMaster API for phone access
tasks.command: $listener = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5001 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $listener | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force }; Set-Location backend; node src/server.js
